exposure: Mifepristone for cervical ripening and labor initiation
normal pregnancies at or beyond term
cohort: 231 women with normal pregnancies at or beyond 37 weeks of gestation
finding: Mifepristone was found to be effective in inducing cervical ripening and labor initiation in women with normal pregnancies at or beyond term.
mod_finding: There were no differences in mode of delivery between the mifepristone group and the expectant management or routine cervical ripening agents group.
